explicit_legacy_names.observed_as: public request vocabulary of the legacy retry alias map and skip whitelist
explicit_legacy_names.resolution_note: Deliberately kept under its legacy spelling. Mapping this legacy public name onto a canonical stage identifier belongs to the versioned target stage registry and its name-level alias map, not to a golden fixture. Renaming it here would silently pre-empt that mapping.

observed_stage_control_vocabularies.note: Transcribed from the frozen legacy source, not from a target registry. The two vocabularies are not the same set: decision_carryover is retryable and not skippable, and findings_merge is present in both.
